g.title: Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Input into Server Interpreters POST /rest/user/login with email set to admin@juice-sh.op'-- and any password. C-05 · Juice Shop Express server No account required Database access relies on concatenated queries (W-001) Full authentication bypass and account takeover of any user, including administrators. Disclosure of customer information Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass or Forge Authentication isAuthorized at lib/insecurity.ts:52 builds express-jwt with only a secret (the public key) and no algorithms list, and the verify calls at lib/insecurity.ts:189 and routes/verify.ts:120 also lack an algorithms allowlist. If the library accepts the header algorithm, an attacker could forge tokens with alg:none (older library versions) or sign an HS256 token using the public key as the HMAC secret, and so forge identities. Library version and default algorithm handling were not shown. C-05 · Juice Shop Express server No account required Authentication relies on hand-rolled token verification (W-011) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Bypass Authorization to Gain Access /encryptionkeys/:file and /support/logs/:file are registered with app.use before any authorization middleware. Any anonymous caller can download key material and access logs by file name. C-05 · Juice Shop Express server No account required Authorization is implemented route by route (W-003) Technical consequence not established. Unauthorized administration and changes to protected business data Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Access Exposed Data and Secrets An unauthenticated attacker uploads a .zip to /file-upload (routes/fileUpload.ts:34) whose entry names contain ../ sequences, such as ../../ftp/legal.md. The entry name is joined to uploads/complaints/ and the write uses the raw entry name. The containment test is absolutePath.includes(cwd), a substring check that any path inside the app root satisfies. The 200 KB multer limit does not confine writes either. Files such as ftp/legal.md or application files can therefore be overwritten outside uploads/complaints. C-05 · Juice Shop Express server No account required Input handling lacks enforced boundary validation (W-002) Arbitrary file write anywhere inside the application directory, enabling content defacement and potentially code overwrite. Disclosure of customer information

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Stored input evaluated as server-side code An authenticated user stores a username of the form #{code}. When GET /profile renders it, routes/userProfile.ts:61 matches the pattern and passes the substring to eval(), executing attacker JavaScript in the Node server process. The persisted record is read at line 41. The only gate is a challenge-enabled feature flag, which is not a security control; the cookie token lookup requires a logged-in user. C-05 · Juice Shop Express server Regular account required Application data crosses into executable code (W-007) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Inject Scripts into Victim Browsers Attacker crafts a /search?q= URL containing an HTML payload with an event handler. C-01 · Angular single-page client Victim interaction required Frontend rendering lacks enforced output encoding (W-006) Script runs in the victim's session and can steal the JWT stored in localStorage or act as the user. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Internet Attacker 2 roles; access details in Identified Actors Unbound OAuth sign-in response accepted At frontend/src/app/login/login.component.ts:148 Google login uses response_type=token with no state, nonce or PKCE, so the SPA cannot bind the response to its own request. An attacker can inject or replay an access token into the redirect fragment, so a victim is signed in as an attacker-chosen identity or has a token leaked. A redirect URI allow-list check exists before OAuth is enabled. C-01 · Angular single-page client Victim interaction required OAuth sign-in requests are not bound to the user's browser session (W-004) Cookie-authenticated changes lack request authenticity checks (W-005) Technical consequence not established. Customer account misuse and disclosure of private account data

Supply-Chain / Build Attacker 1 role; access details in Identified Actors Compromise the Build or Its Inputs Missing Container Image Signing: Unsigned container images cannot be verified for provenance — any registry intermediary could substitute them. C-02 · CI/CD Pipeline Build or dependency access required Authentication relies on hand-rolled token verification (W-011) Technical consequence not established. Service disruption or compromise of application data
g.text: Compromise the Build or Its Inputs
